Commentary.Commentary: The English bowlers were rampant against the Indian top order but failed to bundle the lower order out quickly. Every bowler had their name in the wickets column. They though still will be disappointed with their effort as they could have had a much bigger lead. However, they would now want to put that aside and concentrate on building the lead they already have. India, on the other hand, will look for some early wickets. The ball is swinging and the away side's bowlers will want to make full use of it. Join us in a bit.

Surprisingly, it was the Indian lower order which came to the fore this time around. They have given England a taste of their own medicine. At 160-6, it seemed like the home side would get a big lead under their belt but it was not to be. Vihari and Jadeja joined forces and the two took their time to build a 77-run stand. Vihari impressed one and all on his debut but once he got out a few wickets fell quickly. Although Jadeja's 86 not out, his highest Test score outside Asia, helped India to limit the damage.

What an excellent hour of play this was for India! England came out after the Lunch break hoping to pick the remaining wickets quickly and for once, it also looked like that when Shami and Ishant fell quickly. However, Jadeja and Bumrah frustrated the English side. The former played his shots and the latter hung in there with him and courtesy of their partnership, the lead is not what everyone expected it to be.

OUT! Gone, all out for 292. That's the end of the road for Bumrah and Jadeja. The latter left his partner to do too much as he tapped this flighted one on the pads towards the fielder at short square leg. Broad there runs in and throws the ball back to Bairstow who does the rest. Bumrah was always struggling. A 32-run stand is broken and India have given a handy 40-run lead.
Flatter and on the stumps, Jadeja goes back and pushes it towards mid-wicket. One ball to go, he will be looking for a single.
On the stumps, Jadeja keeps it out.
Three balls, three dots as Jadeja works this with the angle to mid-wicket.
Floats it up on middle, Ravindra defends it out.
A little too full on off, Jadeja strokes it to covers.
And he does it really well! A huge applause for him as he goes back and defends the ball onto the ground.
One more ball to go in this over! Somehow he manages to dig this inswinger out towards short leg.

A muted appeal but nothing! This came back in a long way from off, Bumrah tries to tuck it around the corner but he seems to have missed it. The ball hits his pads and lobs towards short leg. Jennings there takes it and appeals but the umpire does not agree.
As solid as a rock was Bumrah in that defensive stroke. On a length and around off, Bumrah gets behind the line and keeps it out.
The in-dipper but the line was a little too straight. Bumrah misses the flick and gets hit on the pads.
Good length outside the off stump, Bumrah shoulders arms to it.
Stuart Broad is back into the attack.

Drinks! Two wickets and 52 runs in this hour. England's hopes of taking a lead in excess of 50 has been dented thanks to Jadeja's counter-attacking yet watchful innings. The play resumes after the break, hang around for more entertainment.

Ooh! Almost gets chopped on just before the drinks break. This one comes in with the angle and takes the inside edge of Sir's blade. The ball goes to the fielder at short fine leg who gathers it and throws it back quickly. So, no single means JB will be on strike for the next over.
A bit of drift and turn. Perfect seam pitching, gripping and turning away. Jaddu looks to defend it off the front foot but misses.
Another run on offer but not taken. RJ taps this one to the on side again but realizing there are still two balls left, he declines it.
Copy paste stuff from the bowler and the batsman.
Flighted outside off, defended to the off side.
On the pads, pushed to the on side for no run.
Moeen Ali is back as well. Spin from both the ends.
Too full and easily negotiated by JB

Was there a run out chance? It feels that way. RJ gently taps the shortish ball to the on side and runs straightaway. Bumrah wasn't convinced as the ball went to Jimmy at short mid on. He failed to collect the ball cleanly and an easy run results.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.
Flighted up there, defended.
The batsman has driven it through mid off but Jadeja does not take the run.
Adil Rashid to try his luck out against the last wicket.
Angled towards the ribs, Jadeja tucks it fine and keeps the strike for the next over.
Short, outside off, Jadeja pulls it over the fielder previously stationed at long on. He was brought in and hence, it was an easy double for the batsmen.
FOUR! More pain for England as Jadeja is chipping away the trail. A wild hoick across the line to the length ball and it reaches the mid-wicket fence just in time.

Trail under 50 now. Clever, very clever this. He gets the short of a length ball off the inner half of the bat. The ball gently goes towards the long on region. Jaddu calls for a double and his partner obliges. The crowd applauds the genius of Sir!
Gets the length ball to deep covers but denies the single.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Full outside off, Jadeja slashes hard at it and gets it through cover-point for a run but not before Buttler half stops it and helps him. Trail is exactly 50 now.
A wild swing but too wide. A length ball outside off, he fails to connect.
FOUR! Short, on the leg pole and asking for it. Jadeja swivels and gets it fine to the fine leg region for a boundary. Runs coming thick and fast now.
On the pads, Jaddu fails to put bat to ball.

Back of a length ball coming in with the angle. Jadeja looks to play across the line but gets hit on his pads. The ball races towards the third man fence and Stokes there does well to cut it off. A couple of runs taken.
A play and a miss. A short of a length ball outside off, Jadeja goes fishing but misses.
An easy single this. Outside off and easily guided to third man for a single. He keeps the strike for the next over.
Too straight down the leg side, missed.

SIX! Bang! Thwarted! What a hit. Jimmy bowls a full ball in line of the stumps and swings it in. Jadeja counters for that and goes with the straight bat over the bowler's head. The connection is sweet and it goes way back and into the sightscreen.
Swinging in, defended.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Comes in with the angle and RJ gets an inside edge onto the ground.
He leaves the back of a length ball all alone. Bumrah survives. It was closer to the off pole, a lot closer to comfort.
Another bumper and another uneasy, yet important leave.
On a length in line of the stumps, defended.
Some chin music now. He does well to get out of the line.
This one came in viciously from outside the off stump. Bumrah was looking to make an easy leave but ended up getting hit on his arm. The ball goes towards the slip cordon but no harm done.

Oops! Bumrah was ball-watching there else they could have changed strike. It was bowled on leg and Bumrah got something on it. As a result, the ball bounces before reaching Bairstow behind the sticks. Jadeja was half way down there for the run but Bumrah wasn't on the same page as him. Bairstow throws at the bowler's end but not before Jaddu made it in.
Broad to start a new spell with the second new cherry.

FOUR! Wide of off and enticing Jadeja. He chops it from his crease and a thick outside edge makes it race through the slip cordon for a boundary. England won't mind that though. Bumrah is on strike for the next over and they can finish the innings there.
On the pads, flicked away towards deep square leg region. Two runs added to the total.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Full and some room to play with. Jadeja caresses it through covers and takes a brace to stay on strike.
Outside off, cut to point.
Short, on off, defended.
James Anderson is back on.

Dropped! Almost another one there. A flighted wrong 'un outside off, Bumrah plays for the leg spin but it came in, took the inside edge and lobbed towards silly point. Jennings there failed to hold onto the catch and Bumrah survives to fight another day.
Last man, Jasprit Bumrah is in. He needs to hang in there with Jadeja, just like the previous Test where he hung around for over an hour.

OUT! Shami couldn't stop himself for long and pays the price for it. It was tossed up right up there and he lofts it powerfully towards long on. Stuart Broad stationed there runs in a bit, stays low and hangs on to the catch to send Shami packing. All Shami needed was to hang in there with Jadeja but it wasn't to be.
Around off , chopped through the off side for another run.
FOUR! Not that short but enough for the now set Jadeja. He rocks back and half-pulls it through mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence.
Shortish in line of the stumps, Shami goes back and pushes it through the off side and takes a run.
The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side.

FOUR! Fifty up for Jadeja, his ninth in this format. The field was up so it was easy to cut the short ball through the vacant cover-point region. He reaches the milestone, dusts off his willow and does his usual 'swordplay' celebration. Kudos to him, making a statement on his comeback.
And again. He gets the timing right but couldn't beat Buttler at short cover. The field will come up now to save the single.
Once again he moves back to play the shortish ball down the ground.
Shortish, Jaddu rocks back to punch it off the back foot but couldn't get the timing right.
Similar line and length, defended off the front foot.
Flighted and comes in again from the off pole. Jadeja gets some bat on it.
And he does it well as he blocks it right onto the ground.
Flatter on middle, Jadeja goes back and tucks it around the corner with the turn for a run. Shami now has one ball to play out.
This is floated up on off, Jadeja drives it to mid off.
Slightly shorter in length outside off, Jadeja cuts it to sweeper cover and does not take the run.
Again, tossed up delivery on middle, Jadeja blocks it out.
Tosses it up on middle, Jadeja prods forward and keeps it out.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shami is in.

OUT! Gone. Ishant and his resistance ends. A straighter one bowled outside off and it goes on with the arm. Ishant plays for the spin but it never did. The outside edge is found and Bairstow does the rest. Ashwin with his so many variations was looking unimpressive and Moeen with nothing much to show in that department has troubled the Indian batters in the last couple of matches, just like this one. There's a lesson in there somewhere for the Indian ace spinner. Anyway, India still trail by 83 runs.
Similar shot from Jadeja in the same region. One run more.
Shortish on off, Jaddu goes back and chops it through cover-point for a brace.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

Ooh! So close. That could have been easily given. But it went on with the angle. Ali bowls the arm ball and Jadeja looks to defend it. He misses and the ball hits him on his front pad. An appeal ensues but the umpire declines and rightly so.
Gently pushes the full ball down the ground and keeps the strike for the next over.
Outside off, Jaddu pads it away.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Sweeps the fuller ball on the pads to the fine leg region. One run taken.
Down the leg side, Ishant misses it and Jonny takes the bails off. Ishant was already in, so no harm done.
Fast, in line of the stumps, easily negotiated off the front foot.
The ball takes the outside edge goes towards the slip region. They pick up a single.
Outside off, shortish, Jaddu goes back and punched it through the off side for another run.
Shortish outside off, tapped towards point and a quick run stolen.
Gets behind the line of the flighted ball and blocks it out.
Shortish, defended off the back foot.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spin from both ends. Moeen Ali is on from the other end. New ball is available but England have not asked for it.
On the pads, Ishant looks to clip to the fine leg region but it goes off the pads and a run results. Ishant will be on the strike for the next over as well.
In line of the stumps, pushed up there, defended again.
Defended off the front foot by Ishant presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets forward and defends under his eyes.
Driven through the covers by Sharma again.
Starts with a loopy ball outside off, Ishant punches it straight to the fielder at short cover.

The afternoon session is about to get underway. The players are out in the middle. Ishant will be on strike to face the first ball after the break. Rashid will resume the proceedings for the home team. Here we go...
... Day 3, Second Session ...

Hanuma Vihari seemed to be one for the future. In his knock, he showed all the ingredients needed to cook a delicious Test career. For England, it was all about trying hard and asking tough questions. Without much luck though. None of their bowlers can be faulted here. They still have a handy 92-run lead and their target will be to pick the remaining three wickets as soon as possible. Join us at 1340 local (1240 GMT) for the afternoon session.

Another hard-fought session, just like the last two days! Once again only one wicket fell as the batsmen showed a lot of character and determination to survive some challenging deliveries. Credit to the pair of Jadeja and Vihari, who mixed caution with aggression, in their attempt to revive India's fortunes. They added 77 runs before the debutant got out at the stroke of the Lunch break.
Sweeps the full ball on off and survives. One run taken and that's Lunch on Day 3.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Looks to sweep but misses the ball. The ball hits him outside his off pole so no harm in that approach either.
Goes back and pushes the shortish ball through the off side and goes to the safer end.
Similar length on off, blocked.
Flighted on middle and off, defended.
Googly, full but it does too much. Goes down the leg side and Ishant lets it be.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Pushes the tossed up ball to mid off for no run.
Leggie around off, the ball turns from the face of the bat. England go up in the appeal, especially Jonny Bairstow but there was never an edge.
Slow, short, in line of the stumps, punched down the ground for a run. Ishant is on strike now.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Sharma has played that off the front foot and into the ground. End of a successful over.
This one skids on after landing outside off, Sharma plays for the spin and gets beaten.
Ishant Sharma walks in next.

OUT! End of a superb knock by the debutant and his partnership of 77 runs with Jadeja has brought down the deficit to 95. Moeen is the man for England yet again. He serves a tossed up ball outside off and gets it to spin back in just a bit. Hanuma Vihari is forward as he wants to defend but fails to meet the ball from the middle of his willow. It sneaks past the outside edge, Bairstow catches the ball, they appeal and umpire Dharmasena agrees. Vihari goes for the referral and it's quite closer than one would have thought. The inside part of the bat is kissing the front pad at the same time when the ball is going past the outside half. The noise could be of the former but still, there appears to be some deflection when it whizzes past the wood. The third umpire has a good look at it and in his words, he says - no reason to overturn. Hanuma walks back but not before impressing.
Appeal for a caught behind. Umpire Dharmasena raises his finger. Hanuma Vihari takes the DRS.
Flighted and wide outside off, Vihari fails to connect with his sweep shot properly.
Short and on off, turning in, Jadeja goes back and slaps it to sweeper cover for three runs. Adil Rashid does the mopping up job in the deep. His return to the bowler was very ordinary though.
Flighted full ball on off, Jadeja defends it off the front foot to covers.
Change of ends for Moeen Ali. The breeze behind him will help.

Curran goes short, angles it away from the batsman, Vihari gets away from the line easily. Not sure bowling short should be a plan at least with Curran. He ain't express and needs to pitch up in order to fetch some movement which is his stronger suit.
A length ball on off, it's been defended watchfully off the front foot.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Full and in line of the stumps, a bit of away movement, Ravindra Jadeja tries to play it across and closes the face of the bat early. It pops out off the leading edge and rolls towards third man for a run. RJ wanted the second run but it was never on.

Quick single. A length ball outside off, angling away, Vihari gets on the front foot and bunts it in front of mid off. He sets off for a brisk run and reaches safely as Broad misses his shy at the bowler's end.
First delivery is a shorter one, around middle and leg, Jadeja stays back and glances it to deep square leg for a run.
Sam Curran is brought into the attack. Two slips and a gully in place.
Ambitious attempt. A short ball to which Vihari tries to upper cut. He has batted so well until now and would not like to get out attempting a silly shot with lunch around the corner.
Back of a length ball just outside off, Hanuma remains on the back foot and taps it down on the off side.
Full and angling on off, Vihari strides forward and defends it to the leg side.
Stokes darts it short and wide outside off, Jadeja slaps it through point but will get only a run. England now have a fielder in the deep square on the off side. They lead by 101 runs.
Another harmless delivery wide outside off, it's left alone without being entertained.
A gentle delivery, on a good length outside off, not moving much, Jadeja stands back to guard his sticks and then leaves it alone.

FOUR! Strong shot! Moeen is a bit too full with his length, it's around off and turning back in, Hanuma kneels and powers his sweep in front of square leg for a boundary. Growing in confidence, Hanuma.
Keaton Jennings under the lid now. He comes in at silly point. There is already a forward short leg in place along with a slip.
A slider by Moeen, a bit short and skidding into the left-hander. Jadeja goes deep inside the crease and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Two slips in place for Jadeja along with a short cover.
Goes down on one knee, reaches out for it and takes it on the full before paddling it down to fine leg. A single taken.
Lunges to a full ball around off and defends it with soft hands to the on side.
Once again Hanuma defends it towards the point region.
Floated off spinner landing outside off, Vihari gets forward with a big stride and defends.
A length ball on off, Jadeja defends it solidly to the off side.
Smell the leather! Ben bends his back and digs in a short ball around off. It's targeted at the batsman who just leans back a bit to sway away from the line of fire.
Another delivery outside off, left alone by RJ.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length ball angling into the batsman, Jadeja is forward in defense.
FOUR! Boom! Short and wide, begging to be punished, Jadeja stands tall inside the crease and cracks it through point for a boundary. Great start to the over for India.
Once again Vihari lunges forward and across before bringing his bat and pad together in defense. Keeps it out safely.
Takes a big stride forward and defends it compactly.
Spinning back into the batsman, from a shorter length, Vihari goes back to work it across the line but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Leans forward and defends it with the spin.

Appeal for an lbw, not given. Ali lands it outside off, Vihari gets forward and across to defend but is beaten by the excessive spin. He is hit on the pads but the umpire turns down the appeal. The impact is well outside off and it's spinning too much as well.
Tossed up ball outside off, left alone.
Moeen Ali is on replacing the other spinner, Adil Rashid.

NOT OUT! Nothing on the Snicko and once again umpire Dharmasena is right on the money. He is having a great Test match. A good length ball landing just outside off and angling back in, Jadeja sticks back inside the crease but hangs his bat out. Tries pushing inside the line probably but misses. Although after collecting the ball, Bairstow and the English players go up in a big appeal. The umpire stays unmoved. Joe Root goes for the referral but fails to get the decision overturned.
Review time! Jadeja is the man in question as Dharmasena declines a roaring appeal for a caught behind. It looks close though!
Bowls it on a length and outside off, Ravindra allows it through with ease.
Jadeja has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
In the channel outside off, left alone.

Maiden Test fifty for Hanuma Vihari! The Oval explodes to acknowledges this knock from the debutant. Skipper Virat Kohli is also on his feet in the dressing room clapping for him. A length ball around off, Vihari plays it down with soft hands to the off side and scampers across for a single. His partner was also very keen on that run and set off straightaway. A big moment for Hanuma Vihari. All the grind he put in the domestic cricket to get at this stage is finally paying off. Fine innings so far. He has his FC average in the high-50s and is fully justifying it. Can he carry on and get a big one?
Bouncer to begin this over. On and around off, Vihari lets it be.
Rashid drops it short and on off, Vihari slaps it square of the wicket on the off side for a run.

More of an edge that. Turning away from the batsman after landing on a fuller length around off, Vihari tries defending but it gathers a thick outside edge and hurries past first slip and backward point. A couple taken.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Out comes the googly from Adil Rashid. It lands around off, Vihari leans forward and defends it close to his front pad.
A touch flat and short on off, Vihari plays it down towards point.
A low full toss on off, Vihari drives off the front foot but finds the cover fielder.
Ben goes 'round the wicket and lands a length ball on off, Jadeja stays back to block it.
Stokes is straighter in line this time and Vihari works it in front of square leg for a run.
Back defending. Fullish and around off, Hanuma defends it by getting on the front foot.

FOUR! Fine shot. Good placement. Stokes overpitches outside off, Vihari leans forward with a still head and compact balance, opens the face of the bat at the last moment as he leans into the drive and places it through cover-point. It speeds through scattering all the pigeons there and reaches the fence. A couple of fielders were after it but once the ball rolls through the practice pitches, it becomes very tough to stop it.
Stokes runs in with a changed ball and angles it around off. Hanuma draws forward and defends it solidly.
It appears that there is some issue with the ball. It has lost its shape we are told. The umpires are getting it changed. Still 11.5 overs left before the second new nut will be available.
On a good length and around off, Jadeja taps it down towards backward point and collects a single.

50-run stand comes up! This is good going from India and this pair is showing a lot of grit and determination. The debutant Vihari also moves into the 40s. Floated full ball on middle, it's nudged behind square leg for a brace.
Tossed up ball on off, defended off the front foot this time.
Too full this time, around off, Vihari flicks but finds the mid-wicket fielder who dives to stop the ball.
This time Adil fails to land it. Serves a low full toss on off and Jadeja hammers it down the ground. There is a fielder in the deep at long on and they cross for a single.
Rashid goes full this time, around off and turning in, Jadeja drives but finds mid off.
Spinning into the batsman from outside off but the length is on the shorter side. Jadeja gets enough time to go back and block.
Bowls a bouncer to vary things, it's just around off and Vihari ducks. 30 odd runs in the morning and more importantly this pair has braved things quite nicely.
Slips one down the leg side, Vihari attempts flicking it but misses.
Angling into the batsman, on a good length, Vihari defends it with ease.
Solid again. Covers the line of the delivery and presents a straight bat in defense.
This time the line is wide outside off, going straight on, Hanuma watches it closely before making a leave.
Starts with a length ball around off, Vihari covers the line and blocks it safely.
Ben Stokes comes into the attack.
Breather time! India have managed to negotiate the first hour nicely and without any hiccups. The action continues after the short break, stay tuned!
Pads the slower, flighted ball which was pitched outside off. An appeal but the umpire ignores it. Not turning in enough.
Wide of off, defended to covers.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
In line of the stumps, a faster one, defended.
A lot of air and right up there. HV taps it through covers and takes a run.
Tossed up leggie outside off. Jaddu guides it to point and changes strike.
A quick single there. A short ball on the hips, Jadeja gets it to the on side and finds the gap.
Shortish in line of the stumps, defended.
Jadeja shoulders arms to let that one through.
Defends it late and away from his stumps.
On the pads, Jaddu failed to get it away and gets hit on his pads.
Full and wide, easy leave for RJ.
Another googly from Rashid. Vihari gets on the front foot to defend it.
Lunges forward and keeps the slower tossed up ball on off.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wrong 'un from Adil, HV goes back and defends.
Wide of off, left alone.
Tossed up on off, defended.
Adil Rashid is on for the first time in this innings.
Swinging away after landing on off, Jaddu lets it be. Better, much better now.
Back of a length ball on off, defended.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Not so convincing this time. Jimmy lands this one full and closer to the off stump. Jadeja lunges forward to defend but gets it off the outside edge. The ball flies past the third slip and into the fence.
FOUR! 200 up for India. Well played by Jadeja there. He sees the short ball on his off pole and opens the face of the bat to get it through the third man region for a boundary.
Going across the left-hander who lets it be.
Again full around off, defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Edged and a boundary! Closer to the off pole on a full length, Hanuma again plays at it with soft hands and manages to find the gap between first and second slip. The ball races to the fence. Broad is not happy.

Amateurish this from Vihari. Jadeja gently taps the shortish ball towards mid on and calls for a quick single. Vihari obliges. Anderson at short mid on gets to the ball in a jiffy and has a shy at the batting end. Vihari makes it in comfortably but for some reason, does not drag his bat in. Had the ball hit the stumps, Vihari would've been a goner.
In line of the stumps, inside edged to the on side for a quick single.

FOUR! Creamed! Broad bowls a full ball wide of off looking for some extravagant swing. But it's too full and Vihari pounces on it. He brings out the drive and gets it through covers. A beautiful looking shot this and being patient is helping him for sure.
Angling away from the batsman, Jadeja goes fishing to the ball way outside of off and fails.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.

Gutsy, gutsy leave this. Heart in mouth stuff from Jadeja. Anderson changes his angle and goes over the wicket. Lands a shortish ball in line of the stumps and just like a few previous occasions, Jadeja leaves it on a length. The ball goes over the stumps but it was too close to comfort I suppose.
On a length, around off and swinging away from Jaddu who has nothing to do with it.
Too wide again, left alone for the keeper.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, pushed to the off side for a run. Broad is toying with Jadeja by putting the fielder in the deep and bowling it a lot fuller than he has been. Cheeky!
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Moeen Ali has been sent to the deep square leg region for the hook. A short ball coming soon or just mind games?
Full on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his leg stump.
Crouches down and forward to meet the fullish ball with an angled bat and gets it to gully for nothing.
Outside off, on a length, left alone.
Short and wide, left alone.
On off, going away from HV who plays it down solidly.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
A tad fuller around off. Vihari plays with soft hands and the edge rolls to Ben Stokes at third slip.
Closer to off, defended.
In the same corridor outside off, HV lets it be.
Another ball closer to the off pole and another watchful leave. A good contest between patience and will.
And again. A bit fuller but too wide for Jadeja to play at it.
Watchful again from Jaddu. He has left the deliveries outside his off pole very nicely this morning.
On middle and leg, pushed to short mid on for nothing.
In line of the stumps, flicked to the on side for an easy single.
A lot of swing in the air for Broad. Vihari gets in line of the ball pitched outside off and defends it under his eyes. Solid!
Jadeja lets it go. It was outside off and Jimmy couldn't get the batsman to go for a shot. Just one off this over.
Outside off, left alone.

Beauty, both the ball and the leave. Anderson brings the short of a length ball into the left-hander and Jadeja seeing the short length, leaves it to allow it to go over his stumps. Trusting the bounce there, RJ!
Straight, too straight and into the body of Vihari who works it to fine leg and changes strike.
Similar line and length from Jimmy, Vihari lets it be.
Swinging away from the fifth stump line, left alone.
FOUR! Full, on the pads, flicked with ease. Jadeja gets a rare loose ball from Broad and he makes sure he gets it in the gap and all the way to the square leg fence for a boundary.
On a length, on off. The ball gets a thick outside edge and the fielder at third slip stops it on one bounce.
Better, much better from Broad. A lot fuller, a lot straighter and more swing as a result. Jadeja fails to make any connection as he attempts to drive.
Too wide to entice Jadeja into a shot.
Chest high, in line of the stumps, defended.
Shortish on the hips, HV gets some bat on it to work it to the on side for a run.
Covers his off pole with a nice stride and gets his willow away from the line. End of the over, a maiden.
Back of a length ball, on off, Jadeja leaves it on length.
This one comes in with the angle of Jimmy from around the wicket. Jaddu gets on the front foot and keeps it out.
Outside off, shortish, left alone.
Short of a length, outside off, played down carefully.
Wide of off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by Hanuma presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, Jaddu fails to put bat to ball. A leg bye stolen from the fine leg region.
Extravagant movement for Broad. This pitch has lit up. The weather is assisting for sure. Jadeja looks to play the line again but it moves away from the face of the blade.
Short, coming with the angle and then moving away after pitching. RJ plays the line and misses it by some margin.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, shortish, left alone.

Lucky, very lucky. This one was the most dangerous of the lot. Anderson bowls it from wide of the crease and makes it straighten from there after landing it just outside off. HV again hangs his bat in anticipation but misses, once again. End of a magnificent testing over.
Tell you what, third miss in a row. Vihari is trying hard to edge one to the keeper it seems. Could leave these length balls on the fifth stump line.
And another. Vihari looks to defend away from his body and misses.
Some swing for the king again. Vihari hangs his bat at the ball moving away from outside his off stump. He can afford to leave these.
Vihari lets the ball go outside his off stump.

And almost a wicket straightaway. Anderson lands it up there and swings it away from Vihari who has a go with a straightish bat. The ball moves away late and takes the outside edge. The ball however lands short of the fielder at third slip. No harm done.
James Anderson to share the attack with Broad.
Full, around off, left alone by Jadeja to end the first over of the morning.
Good nut. Broad goes fuller around off. Jaddu hangs his bat but misses the line.
Outside off, left alone.
Shortish outside off, RJ opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man. Jennings at gully makes a half stop and a brace results.
On the pads, clipped to square leg for the first run of the morning. Vihari is up and running today.
Nice crunchy sound first up. Broad targets the sticks and bowls a full ball. Vihari punches it to mid on.

We are ready! Out come the Indian domestic cricket legends (if we can call that), Hanuma Vihari and Ravindra Jadeja, with the former boasting an average in the high-50s and the latter possessing three triple hundreds. The debutant will face the first ball of this morning. Stuart Broad has the 51-over old cherry in his hand and has three slips and a short leg in place as well. Get, set, go!

Pitch report - Sanjay Manjrekar says that the pitch has roughs on either side now. Adds that the spinners will surely use it to their advantage. Asserts that the dryness is outside the danger area and there is a tinge of grass in the middle of the track which is assisting the fast bowlers as well.

England have a stronghold on this Test is putting it subtly. Their bowlers have brought them back into the contest after the heroics of Jos Buttler along with the tailenders. Things could've been even better had Anderson got the back of Kohli himself but Dharmasena didn't comply with him. As a result, England's highest wicket-taker in Tests showed dissent and hence, he's fined 15-percent of his match fees and one demerit point. All said and done, we're looking forward to this day, just like the previous ones. Will we see a twist in the tale or will the wheel keep on rolling the same way? The play starts in a short while folks, hang around!

Hello and welcome to the third day of the final Test between England and India. The weather looks bright unlike the visitors' situation in this innings. Day 2 was not what they would've hoped for at the start. However, it's a new day today, a chance to change the fortunes or get washed away by the high tide. Things could change for better or get worse but either way, it promises to be another crucial day for both the cricket power blocs.
... Day 3, First Session ...

Once Curran went through Rahul's defense and brought Kohli in the middle, the ball started to do the talking. Two loose shots from Pujara and Rahane meant that their lower-middle order was exposed and their team was left reeling at 103/4. Kohli, along with the debutant Vihari, added 50 for the fifth wicket but the skipper departed just one run short of his fifty. Vihari is still there in the middle, hanging out by a thread. The third day promises to be another exciting day of Test cricket. We will see you at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, Ciao!

When the play started earlier this morning, everyone was expecting the Indian bowlers to get the remaining wickets as quickly as possible. But, Jos Buttler had other ideas. He played superbly well for his 89 off 133 balls, put on healthy partnerships with the tailenders and pushed the score to 332. In reply, Dhawan failed once again but the Pujara-Rahul stand gave the Indian team some hope.

Well, well, well, someone said at the start of Day 1 that it is a batting paradise, the best they have seen in this series, really? What is going on here now? The hosts have clawed their way back into this Test just like they did in the previous successful victories in this series with the virtue of their bowlers. They chipped away with five Indian wickets in the evening session and have tilted the fulcrum to their side. Anderson and Broad put on an exhibition of reverse swing bowling and broke the visitors' back. Stokes got the big fish, the opposition captain, and Curran and Ali supported equally well to make sure their team ended the day on top.
Full on off, Jadeja defends it watchfully onto the ground. That's Stumps on Day 2.
Shortish on off, kept out off the back foot. Last ball of the day coming up next.
Outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Too full and straight. Jadeja flicks the ball on his pads to the fine leg fence and adds four valuable runs to his team's total.
Comes in with the angle and RJ gets his bat down in time to defend it.
On the hips, worked to fine leg for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Jadeja defends it off the front foot.

FOUR LEG BYES! Down the leg side, Jadeja tries to flick but misses. The ball brushes the pads and races away to the fine leg fence. The umpire first gave it as byes but then corrects himself to signal leg byes.
With the turn works it towards mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Lovely bowling! Moeen floats it up outside off, enticing the batsman for a drive. Vihari plants his front foot forward and tries to drive but misses. The ball turns in, sneaks through the gap between bat and pad. Jonny fails to collect it cleanly.
Slower through the air on off, Vihari lunges and blocks it.
Moeen Ali is back on.
Moeen Ali is back on.
FOUR! Edged and just wide of the third slip. A full ball on off, Jadeja looks to dig it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball races to the third man fence. Stokes ends another successful over
An inside edge on this one. This one comes in with the angle from Ben. RJ looks to defend it from his crease but gets and inside edge onto his pads.
Outside off, left alone.
Jadeja walks in next.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. India have completely lost the plot here. Stokes corrects his line and bowls it on a length around off from 'round the wicket. Rather than bringing down a straight bat, Pant has his bat coming down at an angle and pointing more towards mid on. As a result, the ball takes the edge and Cook, at first slip, pouches it with ease.
FOUR! No stopping this. It was asking to be hit and Pant obliges. A leg slider and a flick was enough to send it across the fine fence.
Outside off, a play and a miss from Pant.
Wide outside off stump, Vihari leaves it alone.
In line of the stumps, defended.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Soft hands saved him. An outside edge was induced there but didn't carry. HV plays the line and the ball moves away a bit, taking the edge on the way.

Good effort in the deep by Buttler. Saved certain runs for his team. Pant flicks the ball which was bowled on his pads. The ball races towards the fine leg fence but Jos stops it in its stride. One run taken.
Full outside off, driven to mid off for a quick run.
Good length again, a little too wide outside off. The batsman need not play at those.
On a length around off, Pant defends it onto the ground.
A little too wide outside off, left alone.
Short and outside off, Pant needs no sighters. He goes after it with a cut shot but gets a bottom edge to the Anderson at third slip.
Rishabh Pant is the next man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Shades of 2014 there! Stokes gets the big fish and it is a timely wicket as this partnership was starting to flourish. Kohli falls one short of a well-deserved half ton. However, I wonder, why did he play that shot when an over ago he had a word with Vihari who attempted a similar shot. Lapse of concentration? Maybe. Stokes bowls it full and wide outside off, it swings away further. Kohli goes for the booming drive through covers, looking to get to his 50 in style. The ball though takes the outside edge and goes towards second slip where Root grabs a good catch. The English crowd and the players celebrate as Kohli walks back dejected. India now have half their side back in the hut and with their captain now dismissed, 332 looks farfetched.
Good length outside off, left alone.

FOUR! However, if he plays shots like these, nobody would tell him to calm down. That is crisp. Full and on off, Vihari eases it through mid off and the ball races to the fence. The 50-run stand is up, a very, very important one in the context of the game. India were struggling when the two joined forces. However, the job is not yet over.
Well, maybe those words of wisdom from Kohli has not worked as Vihari chases a wide ball outside off. Luckily for him, he gets beaten.

A huge appeal but Vihari has smashed the ground. Full and outside off, Vihari goes for the drive but does not connect. There is a noise as the ball passes the bat and the players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The noise was of the bat hitting the ground. Not afraid to play his shots is the young guy, his skipper though wants him to calm down as he walks up to him to have a word.
A well-controlled pull shot to deep square leg for a run. 150 up for India. They trail by another 182 runs.
Looks very confident now! He flicks this to fine leg and takes a run.
FOUR! Boundaries now coming thick and fast for Vihari! On the pads, he flicks it fine and the ball races away to the fence.
Back of a length on middle, HV tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a run.

FOUR! In the air... but just short! Luck going Vihari's way here. He once again tries to pull it. This time though he tries to drag it from outside off. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards Rashid at fine leg. He comes running in but can't reach it. He lets it through and the ball races to the fence.
On the shorter side around off, Vihari defends it.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back.
On a length around off, Vihari defends it.

SIX! Not convincing though but it should break the shackles for him. A bumper on middle, he takes on the challenge of pulling it. The ball takes the top edge and flies over the keeper and into the sightscreen for a biggie.
A couple to end the over! 14 from it. Kohli now is two short of a half ton. Once again on the pads, Kohli works it through square leg and runs two.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Runs again, not a boundary this time but a couple. Full and wide outside off, Kohli strokes it through covers for a brace.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Through the off side this time. A friendly full toss outside off, Kohli guides it through cover-point and the ball races away.
FOUR! Bread and butter stuff for Kohli. You bowl it to him there all day and he will keep murdering you. Full and on middle and off, Kohli whips it through mid-wicket and you need not run for those.
On the shorter side outside off, Kohli guides it through backward point for a couple.
Sam Curran is back on.

Mixing it up here is Stokes! Gets the ball to tail back in now, Vihari misses the flick to get hit high on the thigh pad. Testing times these for the youngster, has done well till now, with some luck.
Good length on off, Vihari is once again quite solid in defense.
Down the leg side, Vihari misses the flick.
The bumper on middle, Kohli somehow pulls it all along the ground towards Moeen Ali at deep square leg for a run.
The away-swinger outside off, Kohli lets it be.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
Another inswinger from outside off, Hanuma lunges and blocks it out.
Back of a length on off, Vihari defends it.
Closer to the off pole this time but not close enough for the batsman to play at it.
Good length outside off, Vihari shoulders arms to it.
A gentle appeal but not given! On a length around middle, this one jags back in late. Kohli misses the ball by a month as it hits him on the thigh pad. Rolls towards square leg for a leg bye.
FOUR! HAMMERED! That made a cracking sound off the bat! Short ball and on middle, Kohli swivels and pulls it through backward square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Outside off, left alone.
Some umbrellas have been opened in the crowd. Seems like there is a slight drizzle, a very slight one, let's just hope it does not get heavier.
The ball is too wide on the off side for the batsman to make any contact.
On the shorter side, Hanuma, from within his crease, defends it onto the ground.
Back of a length on off, Vihari, off the back foot, guides it to point.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
This one stays a touch low! Good length on off, Kohli tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls towards the off side for a run.
Ben Stokes is back on.
On a length around off, Vihari lunges forward and keeps it out.
Good length again on off, Vihari tries to block but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On the body of Kohli, he is hurried into the shot as he mistimes his pull towards square leg for a run.

The inswinger again causing problems for Vihari. The length though is slightly short as Vihari misses the flick to get hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batsmen run a leg bye. Well, the umpire feels it has taken an inside edge so second Test run for Vihari.
A bumper on middle, Vihari does well to play it down with soft hands.

OHHHH! Almost falls into the trap there. This came back in sharply from middle, Kohli flicks it and the ball just bounces in front of Ben Stokes at leg gully. He puts in a dive but can't stop it. A single results.
On off, short of a length, kept out under the eyes.
Vihari picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Works the length on his pads to the on side and changes strike.

In the air... but safe! Almost squares up Virat there. He looks to play the full ball a bit too square and ends up getting a leading edge to it. To his delight, it bounces before the fielder at point.
VK has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Fuller in length on off, Vihari strokes it to mid off.
Plays this one nicely as he defends it onto the ground.
Well, Hanuma can't be at the non-striker's end for long as Kohli tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.

First run for Vihari in Test cricket! A good single there. Also some respite for him now as he will stand at the non-striker's end and watch how the master tackles with such excellent bowling. HV taps it towards covers and takes off. Ali has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
Good length on off, Hanuma defends it onto the ground.

NOT OUT! Yes, height does save him as the ball is going over the stumps. The on-field call has to be overturned and Vihari continues to live a charmed life. This seemed high to be honest. This was another inswinger by Broad. Vihari goes back and tries to nudge it but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire after giving it a thought raises the finger. HV gets a nod from his skipper and the youngster goes for the review straightaway. Time for the replays and they show the ball is bouncing over. Excellent use of technology.
Review time! Vihari has been given out LBW, he though has taken the review. Height can save him here.
Good length outside off, Kohli shoulders arms to it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A little too straight by Anderson, Kohli flicks it through mid-wicket and runs two.
Good length on off, Kohli defends it onto the ground.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Goes very full, Kohli times it back towards the bowler who gets down quickly and makes a very good stop.
Confident drive to end the over! Full and on off, HV strokes it to covers but finds the fielder. End of a testing over.
Now the in-dipper, lovely from Broad. Vihari this time is up for it and flicks it to mid-wicket.
The outswinger this time, Vihari spots it and lets it be.

Howzzat? Not given! Looked close, very close. Not sure why the England captain did not take the review. An inswinger from Broad from outside off. Vihari tries to flick but misses to get hit above the front leg's knee roll. The English players let out a huge appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Root has a chat but opts not to take the review. Oh, okay... replays later show three reds, just as I wrote at the start, not sure why England did not go for the review, especially with two in the bag. Nevertheless, a life for Vihari and he would love to make full use of it.
A confident leave there by the debutant. On a length and outside off, he plants his front foot forward and shoulders arms to it.

Slightly shorter, aimed at the rib cage of the batsman. Kohli tries to flick but the ball brushes his gloves and goes towards short fine leg for a run. So the umpire's signals a leg bye, he might not have felt there was an edge or a glove.
On a length around off, Vihari gets an inside edge onto his pads. End of another beautiful over from Jimmy.

Drinks! What a passage of play for the home team. After the Tea break, they have come out all guns blazing and made the ball talk. Reverse swing is on offer and both, Anderson and Broad, have used it comprehensively. India is in deep, deep trouble. Vihari is the next man in. Can he, along with his skipper, pull them out of troubled waters?

OUT! And another. What a spell from the champion that Anderson is! Rahane goes for a duck. It lands around off and goes away from Rahane with the shine. Rahane, just like Pujara, goes fishing. The edge is found and Cook takes a comfortable catch at first slip. India are under the cosh now and they are still behind by 229 runs.
Rahane has pushed it to the cover region.
Ajinkya opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man.
Rocks back and plays the shortish ball to the off side for run.
Outside off, on a length, left alone.
Driven through mid-on by Rahane for nothing.
Cuts him in half there. A jaffa! It lands outside off and comes back in sharply. Rahane looks to play it off the front foot but the ball goes through his bat and body. A scare survived.
Outside off, left alone.
And now reverse for Broad as well. It lands on off and hits Rahane's pad but down the leg side. An appeal but in vain.
Short ball in line of the stumps, pulled to fine leg for a run. He brings up 18000 international runs. Only the second Indian to do so.
Short of a length outside off, played to point for no run.

Geez! What a legend this man is. He has never been average in his career and he hasn't disappointed today either. Another full ball with the shine on the outside from Jimmy. It lands on middle and leg and moves towards the off stump. Rahane does well to get his bat behind it else he would have been a dead duck in front of the sticks. Phew!
Ajinkya Rahane walks in at no. 5.

OUT! There it is, there it is. If not Kohli then Pujara. England and Anderson will take them all, very happily. A short of a length ball outside off, Pujara has been so good till now to leave them but feels for this one. He ends up nicking it to Bairstow behind the sticks who does the rest. Anderson has now dismissed Pujara six times in Tests, the second most by any bowler. India in a spot of bother now.
Closer to the off pole and tad shorter, Pujara leaves it on a length.
Wide of off, no shot offered.
On off, on a length, defended.
Outside off, left alone.
Clips and clips in the gap. A full ball on middle and leg. Che flicks it through mid-wicket. The short mid-wicket fielder chases it and saves a run for his team. 100 up for the visitors as well.
Solidly defends the short of a length ball down the track.
The ball is too wide on the off side for CP to make any contact.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Flicks the inswinger to the on side for no run.
Outside off, skiddy, Pujara looks to go after it but fails.
Closer to the off pole but Kohli lets it pass again.
On off, defended by Kohli under his eyes.
Again outside off, left alone watchfully by Kohli.
Virat has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On a length, on the fifth stump line, left alone.
Outside off, left alone.
Punches the shortish ball off the back foot to covers.
Pujara has flicked the ball off his pads.
In the same channel and ignored by Pujara.
Too wide to entice Che with a shot.
Outside off, left alone.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Stuart Broad is the next change.
Again defends the length ball under his eyes. End of an eventful over.
VK has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! And a gentle loosener to let him off the hook. It's way down the leg side, Kohli just clips it and gets it to fence ever so easily at fine leg.

Not Out! Kohli hangs on to his life and so frustrating for Anderson. He has bowled 254 balls to Kohli as of now and he is yet to get the Indian skipper out in this series. This one looked out though. Anderson bowled a full ball coming in with the swing after pitching. Kohli plays all over it and fails to connect. The English team cries out in an appeal but the umpire, after a lot of thinking, declines the request. Jimmy is convinced and so is his captain. They take the review. The replays roll in. The impact is umpire's call and that is what saved him else it would have been curtains for Kohli. England do not lose their review but Anderson has a go at the umpire for no reason. He desperately wants to get one up on Kohli for sure. The match referee might request his presence soon!
Review time! An LBW appeal declined by the umpire. Kohli is the man in question as Jimmy is certain it's hitting.
Played to the point region by Kohli.
And almost produced the gems on the very first ball. Kohli reaches for the length ball on the fifth stump channel. He gets beaten but just by a whisker.
Anderson has been brought on to remove Kohli. Can he?
FOUR! Now Pujara gets into the act. Ali again flights it nicely on off. Che comes down the track and crunches it past the bowler and into the fence at long on. Runs coming thick and fast now.
Flighted outside off, VK reaches for it and drives it through covers and changes strike.
Virat works it down the leg side.
And again. He has played it down to the on side for nothing.
A touch fuller but still short. Kohli goes back in quickly and pushes it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and punished. A rare loosener from Ali in line of the stumps. Kohli goes back, swivels and plays the pull to the square leg fence for a boundary.
Sam changes his angle and bowls a yorker on middle and leg. VK clips it through the on side and takes a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
FOUR! Full. Wide. Driven. Boundary. As easy as you like. Gets beaten two balls earlier and drives this through covers handsomely. That's Kohli for you in a gist.
Shortish again around off but this time Virat has time to play it through backward point and take a couple. Good aggressive running from the skipper.
Curran continues to trouble Kohli. He bowls a similar delivery to the one bowled to Rahul. Kohli, just like Rahul, plays for the inswinger but gets beaten inside the line.
Short and wide. Kohli opens the face to guide it fine through the third man region but finds the backward point fielder. Dangerous!
Works the flighted ball to the mid-wicket region and keeps the strike for the next over.
And again works it to the on side for a single. Pujara has looked unfazed by spin.
Too straight and too full from Ali this time. Pujara works it fine and takes a brace.
He lets this shortish delivery spin and plays it late under his eyes.
Similar delivery from Ali and similarly tackled by Pujara.
Shortish outside off. It comes in with the spin and CP plays it down to the on side nicely.
Errs in line this time and bowls it down the leg side. Maybe he is trying to get the ball into the right-hander. Kohli tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Hits the length again on off, Kohli lunges forward and defends it.
Perfect! This is what Curran should be bowling! Full and on off, looking for some movement. Kohli pushes it to covers.
Not the right line to this guy! On the pads, Kohli flicks it through square leg and runs a brace.

A little too wide outside off, Kohli need not play at those. The length was the difference here, the last one was a touch fuller and hence, Kohli was tempted to go after it. This one was slightly short and Kohli is not bothered playing at it.

BEATEN! How much would have the England side loved if that would have taken the edge? Brilliant by Curran. He is in amidst of a brilliant spell here. Once again bowls it full and just outside off, gets it to slant across the batsman. Kohli goes for the drive but is beaten comprehensively. The Indian skipper got out in a similar fashion in the last Test match.
Works this one of his pads and takes a run.

Ooh! Close. Inside edge saved him there. Kohli lunges forward to play the flighted ball which lands in the rough and comes in sharply. The ball goes off the inside edge off the bat and onto his pad. An appeal ensues but the umpire was never in doubt. Root contemplates about the review but decides against it.
He gets to the pitch of this on and works it to the on side for a run.
Flicks the flatter delivery on off for nothing.
Comes down the track but fails to connect with the ball.
Flighted on off, kept out off the front foot.
Virat solidly defends the fullish ball outside his off stump. Young Curran ends a successful over.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
In the same channel for Kohli. It goes off the inside edge of his bat onto his pad. Luckily for him, it doesn't go towards the stumps.
Outside off, on a length, defended.
Greets the Indian skipper with a bumper. Kohli picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Indian skipper Virat Kohli walks in next, in a dicey situation once again. Can he emulate his innings in the previous Tests to get his team out of troubled waters?

OUT! What an absolute peach. Take a bow, Sam Curran. Rahul is beaten all ends up here. He gets a length ball which lands on middle and off and it goes with the angle from over the wicket. Rahul plays inside the line and the ball goes past the bat and clips the top of off pole. He was looking to play the dangerous inswinger from Curran perhaps but failed to pick the variation. England are ecstatic and rightly so. Rahul was looking dangerous and has been sent packing. An early wicket after the break.
Pushes this one to the on side and keeps the strike for the next over.
The floated delivery in line of the stumps is pushed to mid on for a single.
Che comes down the track to smother the spin but get on the pads again. No harm done in the end.
Fullish on the pads, clipped  but straight to the short mid-wicket fielder.
Outside off, tossed up, Che fails to get bat on ball and gets hit on his pads.
Lands the ball again in the rough and it turns in to Rahul. He comes forward to defend but gets an inside edge to the fine leg region. One run taken.
Down the leg side, Pujara failed to get bat to it.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman.
Again short around the rib-cage. Pujara swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple.
Shortish around the same channel, Che punches it off the back foot through covers and takes a brace.
Full ball on off, driven to mid off for no run.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Four byes! Uufff! Risky stuff from KL. He looks to sweep the slower floated ball and it goes agonizingly close to the stumps without touching anything. The slip fielder tries to cut it down and so does the fielder running from the square leg region but both fail. Ali has his hands on his head as he knows he could have had him there. Nonetheless, four byes stolen and more importantly for India, Rahul survives.
Short outside off, cut off the back foot for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes charging down to play the floated ball on off and punches it back to the bowler.
Similar line and tossed up there. Che defends it with a straight bat.
Tossed up outside off, Pujara comes forward and blocks it.
Moeen Ali to share the attack from the other end.
On a length outside off, defended.
On the hips, clipped fine for a run.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out off the front foot.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
FOUR! Cuts and cuts hard. Curran dishes another short ball outside off and Che cuts it fiercely through backward point for the first boundary after the break. The 50-run stand is up between the duo.
Starts with the short of a length ball on off, Pujara defends.
The last session is about to get underway. Players from both the sides are out in the middle. Pujara will be on strike. Sam Curran will continue for England. Here we go again...
... Day 2, Session 3 ...

End of another exciting session. After getting the remaining two wickets, India had a bad start once again. Dhawan misjudged the line of the inswinger and Broad got him right in front of the sticks. However, after his dismissal, things have calmed down for the visitors. Rahul and Pujara have played sensibly and didn't allow any more hiccups. Rahul has been the aggressor and hence, he has managed to score 35, his second best in this series till now. The ball is still doing enough and the contest should be fierce even after the Tea break. The last session will start in a while, keep a cuppa handy. See you soon!
A shorter in length delivery, just outside off is punched off the back foot into the cover-point region to get a brace for the visiting team. That's Tea on Day 2.

Skidder from Moeen, on a fuller length around off. Pujara, instead of coming forward, stays back and tries to keep it out.. The ball skids, takes a thick outside edge and rolls towards the point region to allow the batsmen to run through for a single.
Tossed up in line with the stumps, blocked out off the front foot.
Slower and a bit fuller on the stumps, Rahul comes forward and drives it cleanly to mid on to take a single.
Tossed up around off, Rahul shows the full face of his bat and blocks it onto the ground.
Flatter and a bit shorter on off, Rahul stays back and defends.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A play and a miss. Around the off stump from Curran. Pujara looks to play it from his crease but fails to connect.
The ball is too wide on the off side for Che to make any contact.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Short ball angled across KL, he cuts it through cover-point and changes strike.
FOUR! Very short from Moeen, misses his length. Pujara cashes in as he rocks back quickly and pulls it powerfully through the square leg region to bring up another boundary for himself.

Dropped! That too by the guy retiring soon, very soon. Was very difficult though. Ali tosses this one a bit slower and a bit behind a full length and in line of the stumps. Pujara lunges to defend but the ball lands, grips, spins and bounces a bit more than the batsman expected. It hits him high on the bat on the inside edge and goes to the left of Cook standing at short leg. He tries to grab it with one-hand but the ball does not stick. Reprieve for CP.
Tossed up delivery in line with the stumps. Pujara comes ahead to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but the impact is well outside off.
Ali fires this flatter, outside off. Pujara comes forward to block and keeps his bat behind his pad. The ball lands and turns hitting his pads.
A similar ball on his pads and this time he flicks it into the gap towards the square leg region and gets an easy single.
Tossed up on his pads, flicked to the square leg fielder.
Moeen Ali, England's trump card, comes into the attack.
Keeps it tight on off, Pujara respects the line and length by getting behind the line of the ball and defending it onto the ground.
Sam attacks his pads, Pujara flicks it but straight to square leg.
This time Rahul waits for the length ball to come near him and opens the bat face very late to tap it into the point region and take a single.
Shorter of a good length and attacking the stumps, Lokesh defends off the back foot.
Sam throws it a bit wider, tempting Rahul to go for it. KL has good patience to let it go through without flirting with it.
Sam starts his spell by landing the nut just back of a length on off and angling away. Rahul stands tall and blocks it onto the ground.
Sam Curran, the hero for England in this series, comes into the attack.
Outside the off stump line, Pujara has pulled his bat near his body. The ball whizzes past his bat and into Bairstow's mitts.
Good consistency from England's premium pacer. A similar ball to the previous one and blocked by Pujara in a similar way.
Short of a length ball on off, Pujara has kept it out off the back foot.
Jimmy pulls his length back a bit and that is enough for Rahul to go back and punch it into the cover region and change strike.
Similar delivery and similar solidity shown by Lokesh.
Starts the new over with a good length delivery on the off stump line. Rahul defends it solidly.
Around off, pushed to the off side. No run taken.
Another bouncer and another easy duck for Pujara.
A bumper! Pujara ducks under it.
Pujara defends it from within the crease.
On a length, outside off, Che reaches for it and gets an outside edge. The ball rolls towards the slip cordon.
Short of a length ball around off, pushed to the off side for a run.

Good finish to the over from England's highest wicket taker. Dishes this on a length around off. The ball seams in on landing and takes Pujara's inner edge as he's looking to keep it out. It then deflects onto his thigh pad.
Wider one this, Pujara points his bat to the clouds.
Keeps it on a length just outside off. Rahul taps it towards point to steal a single.
Fuller one around off. Rahul looks to defend off the front foot but gets a bottom edge and the ball rolls towards covers.
This short of a length delivery lands on off and nips back in. The inward nip surprises KL as he tries to whip it but gets hit on the thigh pad.

Beaten! That's a typical Jimmy delivery and beats the batsman. Lands this one on a length around off. The line is very near to the off pole and hence it draws a poke from KL. The ball pitches and moves away further to beat the opener's outside edge. Luckily for Rahul, he's still out there.
Short outside off, cut through cover-point for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

FOUR! Whenever Rahul drives, it pleases the eyes. This may sound like a poetry but that's how his batting style is. It brings the poet out of the person watching him. A full ball from Ben on off, Rahul comes forward, gets on top of it and drives it through covers. A boundary results.
On the 5th stump channel from Stokes and Rahul looks to have a feel of it but misses.
Short on off, defended.
Comes forward to defend the length ball onto the ground.
The ball has been changed in between the overs for some reason. Root showed it to Pujara who wanted to have a feel of it but the request was declined by the English skipper. No love lost there.
Nothing doing to the ball in the same corridor. Watchful Pujara is happy to let it pass to the keeper.
Another easy leave to the length ball outside off.
Full, wide of off, left alone by Pujara.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Gets behind the line of this length ball and keeps it out.
Starts with an outswinger around off and Che defends it to the off side.
Anderson is brought back for another spell from the end opposite to the one where he started from.
Outside off, left alone by KL.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and pulled handsomely to the fine leg region. Stokes targets the grille and Rahul is up to it. He goes after it and gets it to the fence.
The batsman manages only a bottom edge on that one.
Driven through mid off by the batsman.
Looks to cut the short ball but couldn't get it past the point fielder.

FOUR! Great effort from Buttler but couldn't stop the boundary there. Pujara punches the length ball off the front foot and through covers. Buttler there runs after it, dives in front, pushes it back but it hits his foot and rolls back to the fence. The umpire signals a boundary.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Square drives the full ball outside his off stump to the fielder at deep backward point region. A run taken.
Gets behind the length ball and keeps it out off the front foot.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Wide of off, left alone.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot. He is playing the deliveries coming in very nicely and late.
Another solid defense from Che. A length ball, coming in with the angle and it meets the full face of the bat of Pujara.
Hangs back to play the back of length ball onto the pitch.
Outside off, left alone.
Shortish outside off, pushed through cover-point and a run taken.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
FOUR! Touch of Pujara on display. Broad errs in line and bowls it on the pads. CP tucks it fine on the leg side for a boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Similar line and length from Broad and Pujara is happy to block it out.
Back of a length ball, defended.

In the air... and safe! Rahul is looking to be aggressive and rightly so but this time, he fails to get the timing right. He gets a full ball on off. Looks to loft it over the infield at covers but gets it off the outer half of the bat. The ball goes over the head of the fielder at mid off and a run is taken in the end.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On a length, outside off, left alone.
Wrists the shortish ball through the on side and takes a single.
On middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket for another easy run.
A bit comical, this. Rahul lost his shoe while taking a run and it follows him for a couple of seconds. Stokes, ever so helpful, picks it up for him, gets the laces untied and hands it over to Rahul.
Tucks this length ball to the on side and takes a quick single. Rahul lost his shoe in the process but that doesn't stop him from completing the single.

FOUR! Goodness, gracious! This is out of the top bracket from Rahul. Stokes dishes a full ball outside off. He sees the width and lines it up. He gets low, gets his bat under the ball and lofts it up and over the cover region. The ball lands just inside the fence and goes over. The crowd applauds the beauty of a shot that was.
Ben Stokes comes in to bowl.
Another in-swinger from Broad. Rahul hangs back and shows the full face of the bat. The ball goes through the off side and a run is taken.
Comes in with the angle again. Pujara clips it off his pads and takes a run.

A play and a miss. So close to the edge. Broad bowls a short of a length ball around off and entices CP into a shot, who does that exactly. He, though, fails to get in line of the ball and gets beaten. Some oohzzz and aahzzz in the English camp.
Swings in prodigiously. Pujara plays it late and with the swing to the on side.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, on a length, kept out.
Driven towards the mid off region. Dot to end the over.

FOUR! Class! Not the kind of shot you'd see everyday. Anderson lands this one shortish around off and KL goes back to late cut it through the slip cordon and gully region. The ball beats the gully fielder and races to the fence.
A thick edge but doesn't carry. Rahul does well to play it with soft hands. The ball takes the outside edge but no harm as it goes to third slip on a bounce.
This one comes in sharply. Rahul plays it late from his crease and taps it down adjacent to the pitch.
On a length around off, KL defends it down.
Outside off, left alone.
Solid defense from a solid player. Broad keeps this last nut of the over on a good length around off. Pujara gets in line of the delivery and blocks it out.
Keeps it in line with the stumps and a bit behind a good length. CP rocks back and keeps it out from his crease.
Wide of off stump, Pujara will leave those all day long.
On a good length just outside off. Pujara comes forward and blocks it out.
Che is welcomed with a full pitch one around off, Pujara drives it politely to mid off, very Pujara-like.
Cheteshwar Pujara is the new batsman in.

OUT! Big breakthrough for England this and very early into the innings too. Dhawan has been given out LBW. He has a chat with Rahul and then signals 'T' to the umpire. But, he was so engrossed in his discussion with his partner that it seems he forgot about the 15 sec rule of DRS. As soon as he signals for the review the umpire informs him that the 15 secs are over and he cannot review it now. The Indian opener has to make the long walk back. Getting back to the dismissal, Broad starts off with the perfect delivery from around the stumps, in the corridor of uncertainty and angling into Dhawan. The southpaw prods forward to defend but the inward movement does him in and the ball raps him on his pads. Broad and his teammates instantly go up in a big appeal and the umpire also supports their point of view and raises his finger. Dhawan, dejected, walks back with face down. India lose their first. Can the hosts make more inroads?
Stuart Broad to share the attack.
Straying down the leg side, Dhawan clips it off his pads and places it through square leg for one.

Fine shot! A touch short and outside off, Dhawan rises with the bounce and steers it through point. Moeen chases it down near the rope as the ball slows down. They take a couple of runs. Dhawan is off the mark as well.
Closer to the off stump this time. It's on a length and Dhawan is forced to defend it from the back foot.
Serves it on a length and just outside off, holding its line after pitching, Dhawan stays back to cover his stumps and then shoulders arms.

Anderson switches to 'round the wicket for Dhawan but he slips a length ball down the leg side. It's left alone and Bairstow dives across to his right to collect the ball. A good warm-up for the keeper.
Off the mark first ball! Anderson starts with a back of a length delivery in the channel around off. Rahul stays back footed and punches it through covers for three runs. India are away as well.
